_what: Upload by link (link_host.py): a video goes into a private Google Cloud Storage bucket, Meta fetches it from a V4 signed URL that expires, and the object is deleted once Meta has processed it. One Meta call per video instead of ~17. No bucket set, the switch off, or any failure = the chunked upload as before.
_setup: Each machine sets its own private bucket here (public access prevention on, objects deleted after 1 day) and puts a service-account key with Storage Object Admin on that bucket only in the key file under `key`; then "on": true.
_rollback: "on": false, or META_UPLOAD_LINK_OFF=1 on one machine: every video goes chunked again.
